subject: prd/impl-review
statement: Within each assurance pass, when the worker applies or disputes a blocking finding, the reviewer shall record the disposition and may run one scope-locked remediation re-review over named defects plus changed spans; declined blocking findings shall escalate under FR-31, a third internal round shall be refused, and no remediation round shall satisfy another assurance-pass requirement.
rationale: remediation verifies closure inside one independent judgment lineage; counting it as critical corroboration would be false independence
fit_criterion: per-pass fixtures enforce the two-round cap, mandatory dispute reason, declined-blocking escalation, unchanged-content withholding, and a distinct top-level pass identity for critical pass two
